visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long wavy hair sits by a train window, looking extremely surprised with his mouth wide open as the word WOW appears in bold white text. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a bento box wrapped in a gray textured cloth with a white paper band reading 'Taiwan Railway Bento'. (2) The man's hands untie the knot of the gray cloth. The camera cuts to a top-down view of a round metal bento box containing what looks like a classic Taiwanese bento: a large fried pork chop, bright green vegetables, corn pieces, and a half-cut soft-boiled egg. (3) A metal spoon scoops up a portion of the 'pork chop' and 'vegetables,' revealing a dark cake texture underneath. The man is then shown eating the spoonful with a look of intense concentration. (4) Close-up shots show the man pointing to the food as he speaks. He holds up a spoonful showing a dark brownie layer, a white creamy layer, and green sponge cake on top. Text overlays explain the ingredients. (5) The man continues to eat, gesturing with his hands. The camera focuses on the 'corn' which is being lifted by a spoon; it has a detailed yellow exterior and a white inner core. (6) A close-up shows the 'egg' being held up; the yolk is a translucent yellow jelly and the white is a solid opaque texture. (7) A woman with long brown hair and bangs appears briefly, nodding and smiling as she talks. The man is seen again, laughing and looking towards the camera while continuing his review.
